newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spanish Q3 household spending rose 1.89 pct yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: Spanish Q3 household spending rose 1.89 pct yr/yr.

text.p: Average spending in Spanish households rose 1.89 percent to 731,843 pesetas in the third quarter compared with the same quarter a year earlier, the INE National Statistics Institute said on Thursday.
That compares with a 0.22 percent year on year fall in the second quarter.
Third quarter average household spending rose 1.72 percent from the second quarter, INE said.
In constant peseta terms, average spending declined 1.71 percent in the third quarter from a year earlier.
